facts.fact: The Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS) vertical of PMAY-U 2.0 is implemented as a Central Sector Scheme
facts.quote: The Mission, will implement Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS) vertical as a Central Sector Scheme to expand institutional credit flow to the affordable housing sector.

facts.fact: Income limits: EWS up to Rs 3 lakh, LIG Rs 3-6 lakh, MIG Rs 6-9 lakh annual household income
facts.quote: EWS households are defined as households with an annual income of up to ₹3 lakh. LIG is defined as households with an annual income from ₹3 lakh up to ₹6 lakh. MIG is defined as households with an annual income from ₹6 lakh up to ₹9 lakh.

facts.fact: The interest subsidy is 4.0% on the first Rs 8 lakh of the loan
facts.quote: Households having income up to ₹9 lakh, loan value up to ₹25 lakh for property value up to ₹35 lakh would be eligible for a subsidy at 4.0 % on first ₹8 lakh for a tenure up to 12 years.

facts.fact: The 4% subsidy is for a loan tenure of up to 12 years
facts.quote: Households having income up to ₹9 lakh, loan value up to ₹25 lakh for property value up to ₹35 lakh would be eligible for a subsidy at 4.0 % on first ₹8 lakh for a tenure up to 12 years.

facts.fact: Only home loans up to Rs 25 lakh qualify
facts.quote: Only loan up to ₹25 lakh with the house value up to ₹35 lakh will be eligible for subsidy under this vertical.

facts.fact: The house value must be up to Rs 35 lakh
facts.quote: Only loan up to ₹25 lakh with the house value up to ₹35 lakh will be eligible for subsidy under this vertical.

facts.fact: The carpet area of the house must be up to 120 sqm
facts.quote: The carpet area of houses under this component shall be up to 120 sqm.

facts.fact: The maximum subsidy is Rs 1.80 lakh actual release
facts.quote: A maximum release of interest subsidy of ₹1.80 lakh having maximum NPV of ₹1.50 lakh (at Discount Rate of 8.5%) shall be provided to eligible beneficiaries having a loan tenure of more than five years.

facts.fact: The maximum subsidy has an NPV of Rs 1.50 lakh at an 8.5% discount rate
facts.quote: A maximum release of interest subsidy of ₹1.80 lakh having maximum NPV of ₹1.50 lakh (at Discount Rate of 8.5%) shall be provided to eligible beneficiaries having a loan tenure of more than five years.

facts.fact: The subsidy is available only for a loan tenure of more than 5 years
facts.quote: A maximum release of interest subsidy of ₹1.80 lakh having maximum NPV of ₹1.50 lakh (at Discount Rate of 8.5%) shall be provided to eligible beneficiaries having a loan tenure of more than five years.

facts.fact: The subsidy is released in 5 equal yearly instalments
facts.quote: Subsidy to the beneficiaries will be released in 5 equal yearly instalments.

facts.fact: The instalments are paid by DBT into the beneficiary's loan account
facts.quote: The subsidy will be released in 5 yearly instalments through DBT in loan accounts of beneficiary provided loan is active at the time of release of subsidy and more than 50% principal is outstanding.

facts.fact: Each instalment is released only if the loan is active and more than 50% of the principal is outstanding
facts.quote: The subsidy will be released in 5 yearly instalments through DBT in loan accounts of beneficiary provided loan is active at the time of release of subsidy and more than 50% principal is outstanding.

facts.fact: The subsidy is credited against (deducted from) the principal loan amount
facts.quote: Subsidy will be credited by the PLI to the borrower’s account upfront by deducting it from the principal loan amount of the borrower.

facts.fact: Only home loans sanctioned and disbursed on or after 01.09.2024 qualify
facts.quote: Subsidy will be provided on home loans sanctioned and disbursed on 01.09.2024 or after to eligible beneficiaries of EWS/LIG and MIG for purchase/ re-purchase/construction of houses.

facts.fact: The loan must be for purchase, re-purchase or construction of a house
facts.quote: Subsidy will be provided on home loans sanctioned and disbursed on 01.09.2024 or after to eligible beneficiaries of EWS/LIG and MIG for purchase/ re-purchase/construction of houses.

facts.fact: The family must not own a pucca house anywhere in the country
facts.quote: Families belonging to EWS/LIG/MIG category, living in urban areas, having no pucca house anywhere in the country, are eligible to purchase or construct a house under PMAY-U 2.0.

facts.fact: A borrower who moves the loan to another lender by balance transfer cannot claim the subsidy again
facts.quote: In case a borrower has taken a housing loan from one PLI and later on switches to another PLI for balance transfer, such beneficiary will not be eligible to claim the benefit of interest subsidy again.

facts.fact: The subsidy is given only once for a property
facts.quote: The subsidy under the scheme will be provided only once for a property.

facts.fact: Demand is registered on the PMAY-U 2.0 unified web portal and the application is then forwarded to the lending institution (PLI)
facts.quote: For availing the benefit under ISS vertical, eligible beneficiaries will be required to register their demand through Unified web-portal. Subsequently, the application will be forwarded to the concerned PLIs

facts.fact: The pmaymis.gov.in portal has the 'Apply for PMAY-U 2.0' option for applicants
facts.quote: Citizen Services List of Applications Under PMAY 2.O ISS Subsidy Calculator Track Application Status Support/FAQs List of ULB Apply for PMAY-U 2.0

facts.fact: The old CLSS vertical of PMAY-U closed on 31.03.2022
facts.quote: The component of CLSS has been closed on 31.03.2022.

summary: All ISS terms (4% on first Rs 8 lakh, 12 years, Rs 25/35 lakh caps, 120 sqm, Rs 1.80 lakh / NPV 1.50 lakh, 5 yearly DBT instalments, loans from 01.09.2024) confirmed in the PMAY-U 2.0 guidelines.
